principles.selective_roles: Do not invoke every discipline mechanically; select only roles relevant to the change.
principles.handoff: Each phase must hand off explicit artifacts/constraints to the next phase.
principles.quality: Code-changing work requires QA evidence and code review before final delivery.
principles.worker_job_size: Prefer small bounded specialist worker jobs with one measurable gate after each job.
principles.repair_budget: A failed worker delivery gets at most one worker repair attempt using objective gate feedback; after that Codex takes over.
principles.worker_route_semantics: WORKER is for bounded mechanical/execution-heavy work without substantial Codex pre/post judgment. Codex-owned framing plus worker execution plus Codex review is HYBRID.

sequence: Codex defines bounded handoff and measurable gate
If gate fails: one repair job receives objective failures and original contract
Codex emits final factory outcome telemetry

preferred_decomposition.backend-data: Backend/domain/API plus tightly coupled persistence only
preferred_decomposition.qa: Focused test implementation/execution after implementation exists
preferred_decomposition.devops-platform: CI/CD/IaC as a separate bounded job
